messages:
emily_marketing: Team — quick sync: CloudLeap partnership + marketplace listing + joint webinar. want a compact co-marketing plan we can approve by EOD Fri. high-level ask: marketplace launch + blog + benchmark narrative + webinar the week after launch + lead routing. who's in? :wave:

sam_partnerships: I can own partner coordination and marketplace timeline. CloudLeap wants listing live before the webinar. they prefer 2 weeks lead time for collateral review.

emily_marketing: ok timeline: target listing go-live 2024-06-14, blog & benchmark post same day, webinar 2024-06-21. that gives CL one week for review after our draft. realistic?

jordan_prod_marketing: timeline works. i'll draft the benchmark narrative — focus on latency & cost comparisons for typical gen-chat workloads vs. public endpoints. will need test configs and a short prompt suite from eng-ml.

kelly_growth: i'll own the blog + landing page copy and registration flow. suggest UTMs: utm_source=cloudleap, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=cl-marketplace-launch. also want a 1-click CTA to request a dedicated capacity trial.

raj_sales: routing note: all marketplace & webinar signups should create SFDC leads with record type=Partner_Inbound, lead_owner queue=Marketplace_Partnerships. please add field: "partner_origin" = CloudLeap. I can add automation to tag and route to AE queue.

emily_marketing: perfect. jordan/kellly — can you share a snippet of the UTM and lead capture payload so Raj can map?

jordan_prod_marketing: here's a quick payload suggestion:

```
POST /webhooks/lead-capture
{
  "email": "...",
  "name": "...",
  "company": "...",
  "utm_source": "cloudleap",
  "utm_medium": "partner",
  "utm_campaign": "cl-marketplace-launch",
  "partner_origin": "CloudLeap"
}
```

kelly_growth: good. i'll wire the registration form to that endpoint and add a hidden field for partner_origin.

raj_sales: once leads hit SFDC queue, i'll run an immediate dedupe + enrichment (clearbit) then set lead status = "Needs Qualification". AE assignment split by region: NA/EU/APAC.

sam_partnerships: on marketplace checklist: listing copy, 1x 800x800 logo, 3 screenshots, quickstart guide (GH link), pricing blurb, compliance checkbox. CloudLeap requires the listing to reference a verified integration doc. Jordan — can you produce the quickstart link by Tue?

jordan_prod_marketing: yes — will push a small doc to GH: github.com/redwood-inference/cloudleap-quickstart and share before Tue EOD.

emily_marketing: webinar content: 35 min (20 min demo + 10 min benchmark walkthrough + 5 min Q&A). speakers: Jordan (product), CloudLeap PM (TBD). Kelly — you handle registration & promo emails. Sam — coordinate co-hosting details.

kelly_growth: promo plan: 1 announcement email to our list (segment: infra + platform), 1 partner co-send, 2 reminder emails, socials (X/LinkedIn). can we get 2-week notice to promote?

sam_partnerships: CloudLeap will promote to their customers, yes. they want co-branded slides and a rehearsal 3 days prior.

emily_marketing: measurement — success metrics: 500 registrants, 80 demos requested, 150 MQLs attributed to campaign within 30 days, and marketplace listing acceptance by CloudLeap. anything to add?

raj_sales: add pipeline conversion target: 10 SQLs within 60 days, and 2 closed deals as stretch.

jordan_prod_marketing: for the benchmark narrative — i'll include methodology section + reproducible commands. sample workdir and commands below for eng-ml to reproduce:

```
# reproduce benchmark
pip install -r requirements.txt
python run_eval.py --model redwood-v1 --seq_len 1024 --batch 8 --prompts prompts.json
```

emily_marketing: good. eng-ml will need these by Mon so we can run and finalize charts. Sam — confirm CloudLeap will allow us to publish joint benchmark? sometimes partners want data review redactions.

sam_partnerships: checked — they allow publication but want to review numbers and request anonymization of their internal customers. we'll circulate before posting.

kelly_growth: creative ask: need hero image + 2 screenshots + co-brand logo lockup. jordan — can you provide assets?

jordan_prod_marketing: yes, pushing assets to Figma by Mon.

raj_sales: lead scoring: set 50+ employee company OR job_title contains (Platform Engineer|CTO|Head of AI) -> MQL. Also flag any signups that request a dedicated capacity trial as high intent.

emily_marketing: routing detail: marketplace leads (from marketplace listing) -> tag marketplace_source; webinar leads -> tag webinar_source. Raj, can your automation add these tags?

raj_sales: yes, will map utm_campaign and the incoming partner_origin to set those tags.

kelly_growth: calendar + promo schedule: I'll draft and share by Fri. also want a short 1-pager co-marketing brief for legal review — Sam can loop their legal if needed.

sam_partnerships: will loop in CL legal after our draft.

deploybot: Calendar invite created: "CloudLeap x Redwood — Co-marketing planning" 2024-05-06 10:00AM PT. link: https://calendar.fake/abc123 :calendar:

emily_marketing: next actions: 1) Jordan: benchmark draft + quickstart GH link (Mon). 2) Kelly: landing page + registration + promo schedule (Fri). 3) Sam: partner review plan + legal (Tue). 4) Raj: SFDC queue + lead mapping + automation (Tue). 5) Emily: finalize PR/announce copy and measurement dashboard (Fri). please react with :thumbsup: when you own an item.

jordan_prod_marketing: 👍
kelly_growth: 👍
sam_partnerships: 👍
raj_sales: 👍

emily_marketing: thanks — i'll compile this into a short brief and post here. we should aim to lock creatives and benchmark numbers by next Tue so CloudLeap has time to review. :rocket:
